plan.title: Child Progress
plan.subtitle: Comparing progress between genders

panels.title: Total children
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM baseline

panels.title: Average shuttle run time by gender
panels.sql: SELECT Gender, AVG(Shuttle run sec) AS avg_shuttle_run FROM baseline GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Average sit ups by gender
panels.sql: SELECT Gender, AVG(Sit ups) AS avg_sit_ups FROM baseline GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Gender demographics
panels.sql: SELECT Gender, COUNT(*) AS count FROM baseline GROUP BY 1

plan.narrative: This page compares the progress of boys and girls. The first panel shows the total number of children. The second panel displays the average shuttle run time for each gender, allowing for a comparison of cardiovascular fitness. The third panel shows the average number of sit-ups for each gender, indicating strength. The fourth panel provides a breakdown of the number of children by gender.
